Parent-reported CTest7/7 and Node8/8 and bank consumer6/6 were not independently rerun. Repository storage-lease-regressions.txt was read and records unittest193 OK; this does not reach standalone or player live package assertions.

Private bank-player-latest-archive proves one exact bank player archive ordinary startup and selector, no visual card claim; SDK-source-release proves source/runtime sealing, not native-counter player acceptance. bank-human-card-core-live-final includes screenshot/input/card evidence and resident core lifecycle; visuals themselves were not independently inspected in this review.
No mutation run performed; corruption-test finding is a directly checked absence of a negative case, not an assertion that current checksum code is wrong.

Configured tests rules are prose, with no supplied deterministic regex. Test skip scan found explicit Windows conditions and optional emulator skip; recorded Windows193 OK does not imply all future environments collect emulator cases.
TypeScript/React/Vitest-specific clauses of tests-architecture are N/A to this Python/C++ diff; behavior, determinism, false-green and boundary clauses apply.

Recheck retained the fixed publication base and all78 path dispositions; the follow-up deeply inspected the five changed producer/consumer/test paths, adding plugin_core to targeted claims. No new full-tree or live attestation is implied.

resolved_findings.why_this_severity: The current test oracle rejects the archive producer output and surfaces a failed acceptance report to the user (questions 3, 4, 7, 8); confidence comes from reading both producer and consumer, without launching a game.
resolved_findings.problem: Live acceptance archive membership checks contradict the current release producer. Player backend omits mandatory NOTICE.txt. Standalone extended acceptance still requires wsock32.dll and omits d3d9.dll, NOTICE.txt and README.txt; it also reads the absent wsock32 entry immediately afterward.
resolved_findings.scenario: Run xkit check --player on an otherwise successful development check: plugin-watch.update writes the six-entry native release including NOTICE.txt; plugin-player-check requires exactly five entries and raises AssertionError before player launch. Run standalone plugin-check.py --live or --live --core: the current producer archive fails its obsolete membership assertion before delivery verification. A valid package is reported failed.
resolved_findings.evidence: scripts/plugin-watch.py:575-580 writes plugin,dinput8,d3d9,NOTICE,release and README. tests/test_plugin_watch.py:906 tests the producer archive including NOTICE. tests/test_xalkit.py:895 mocks the entire player subprocess, and :926 exercises source guards/cleanup only, so neither reaches the contradictory package-membership oracle.

resolved_findings.why_this_severity: The untested integrity boundary is a trap for a future edit rather than a demonstrated current incorrect restore (question 5).
resolved_findings.problem: New dump restore integrity and partial-output cleanup branches lack a negative regression case.
resolved_findings.scenario: A future edit removes the restore_dump digest comparison: a valid gzip containing same-size changed bytes is restored despite the recorded SHA. The current successful-roundtrip and outside-root-refusal tests still pass, allowing a corrupt diagnostic artifact to be treated as verified.
resolved_findings.evidence: Read full tests/test_sdk_storage.py. Only test_old_dumps_are_losslessly_archived_and_restorable enters restore_dump with an archive inside the root; test_dump_restore_rejects_an_archive_outside_the_storage_root exits before decoding. No inside-root corrupt gzip, mismatched SHA/size, insufficient restore space or write-failure case reaches the integrity/temporary cleanup branches. The existing archive-failure test covers retirement testzip, not dump restoration.

recheck_evidence: scripts/plugin_core.py:199 validates the real six-member archive, ABI3, CRC, and plugin/loader/graphics hashes; scripts/plugin-player-check.py:215 and scripts/plugin-check.py:416,:545 use that validator. Standalone release stages the graphics facade and no longer reads wsock32 from the package.
tests/test_plugin_watch.py:906 invokes the real producer plus shared validator, checks NOTICE bytes, and rejects missing NOTICE and changed graphics.

tests/test_sdk_storage.py:263 supplies valid gzip containing same-size changed bytes against correct provenance and verifies checksum failure, retained archive/provenance and absent destination/temporary output. This reaches sdk_storage restore_dump digest rejection rather than a preceding path/provenance guard.
Parent reports targeted watch38/storage17 passing. No independent rerun, game launch or input use performed.

CI fixture recheck: tests/test_game_control.py:333,:356 now resolve TemporaryDirectory roots before stage/restore. This removes Windows8.3 TEMP spelling differences while leaving production validate_player_path and redirected-directory negative regression at :294 unchanged. Reviewed git diff contains exactly these two fixture lines. Parent reports local test_game_control32 PASS; hosted CI37692600703 failed on previous fixture spelling. CI log not found at the known evidence-folder path and not independently read.
